titleBack: Well Trained In The Jedi Arts

flipToBack.prose: Flip if you control two Tatooine battleground sites (at least one controlled with a Dark Jedi), occupy Tatooine system, and opponent controls no Tatooine sites.

children.req: control (count 2): you control 2 Tatooine battleground sites
control-with: at least one Tatooine battleground site controlled with a Dark Jedi
control (opponent): opponent controls any Tatooine site

flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if opponent controls MORE Tatooine sites than you (strict count comparison).

children.req: count comparison: opponent-controlled Tatooine sites > your controlled Tatooine sites

requirementSemantics: Front flip mixes CONTROL (2 Tatooine battleground sites), CONTROL-WITH (>=1 of them with a Dark Jedi there), OCCUPY (Tatooine system - presence suffices, control not needed), and an opponent CONTROL-zero constraint on the broader class Tatooine sites (not just battlegrounds).
SpotOverrides differ per leaf: site controls use INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE; the system occupy and the opponent-control check use INCLUDE_CAPTIVE_AND_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE.
Flip-back is a strict COUNT COMPARISON (opponent > you) over controlled Tatooine sites, not a fixed threshold: ties are safe.
No hard-lose/out-of-play condition on either side.
typedIdentities: Filters.Dark_Jedi (flip control-with actor); Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.Dark_Jedi) (back move-cost anchor)

Filters.Tatooine_Occupation (back once-per-game download); Filters.and(Filters.Tatooine_site, Filters.battleground) via DeployCardFromReserveDeckEffect(Filters.Tatooine_site, Filters.battleground, true) (front download)
setupAndPullRoutes: Setup (required on objective deploy): deploy Tatooine system (Filters.Tatooine_system) and one non-Jabba's-Palace Tatooine site (Filters.and(Filters.Tatooine_site, Filters.not(Filters.Jabbas_Palace_site))) from Reserve Deck (Card301_004.java:45-62).
Front once per turn (TWIN_SUNS_OF_TATOOINE__DOWNLOAD_TATOOINE_BATTLEGROUND_SITE): use 1 Force to deploy a Tatooine battleground site from Reserve Deck (Card301_004.java:74-97).
Back once per game (WELL_TRAINED_IN_THE_JEDI_ARTS__DOWNLOAD_TATOOINE_OCCUPATION): deploy Tatooine Occupation from Reserve Deck (Card301_004_BACK.java:52-65).
Back once during your control phase: peek at top 2 cards of your Reserve Deck, take one into hand, shuffle (Card301_004_BACK.java:69-84).
otherObligations: Front remainder-of-game deploy ban: you may not deploy Jabba's Palace sites or Sandwhirl (Card301_004.java:65-71).
Back: opponent needs +1 Force to move a character or vehicle from a site shared with your Dark Jedi (MoveCostFromLocationModifier) (Card301_004_BACK.java:90-94).

Strategic: front needs a Dark Jedi parked on a controlled Tatooine battleground site plus system occupation plus a fully evicted opponent (zero controlled Tatooine sites); after flip, never let opponent out-control you on Tatooine sites.

profileGaps: flipGateSite null: gates are 2 controlled Tatooine battleground sites plus occupied Tatooine system; present only as generic named-location recipes with no control/occupy semantics
keyCharacterFilter null: at least one gate site must be controlled WITH a Dark Jedi (Filters.Dark_Jedi)
